name: qrlink
description: A QR-code that can change where it points to

scripts.backend:dev: cd backend && npm run watch && cd ..
scripts.backend:build: cd backend && npm run build && cd ..
scripts.frontend: cd frontend && npm run start && cd ..
scripts.frontend:dev: cd frontend && npm run dev && cd ..
scripts.frontend:build: cd frontend && npm run build && cd ..
scripts.install: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install && cd ..
scripts.docker:build: npm run docker:clean;  docker build -t qrlink .
scripts.docker:create: docker create --init --cap-add=SYS_ADMIN -e API_URL=http://localhost:3000 -e UI_URL=http://localhost:8080 -e IS_DOCKER=1 -h QRLink --name QRLink --privileged -p 3000:3000 -p 8080:8080 --restart on-failure:3 qrlink:latest
scripts.docker: npm run docker:build && npm run docker:create && npm run docker:start
scripts.docker:clean: docker stop QRLink && docker rm QRLink && docker rmi qrlink:latest
scripts.docker:mongo: npm run docker:mongo:pull && npm run docker:mongo:start

author: Inimi
